title: Double Drip Blue Razz Lemonade Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Double Drip Blue Razz Lemonade blends tangy Blue Raspberry with a splash of sparkling Lemonade for a fizzy fruit vape full of energy and zing. The Blue Raspberry delivers sweet and slightly sour berry notes, while the Lemonade adds a citrus lift and gentle effervescence. The result is a bright, juicy flavour with a refreshing finish that captures the nostalgic taste of fruity soft drinks. Crafted with nicotine salts for fast-acting satisfaction and a smooth throat hit, this 50VG/50PG e-liquid is perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. It pairs best with low-powered pod kits , starter vape pens and compact refillable devices , offering consistent performance and well-balanced vapour production. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Double Drip Nic Salts are available in a wide range of bold and satisfying flavour profiles to suit everyday vaping. Double Drip are one of the most celebrated and influential e-liquid brands in the UK and the masterminds of some of the most iconic vape flavours ever made. Vibrant, authentic, and highly inventive flavours are a hallmark of all Double Drip vape juices, and this newest collection of truly timeless flavours in smooth, satisfying nic salts won’t disappoint.
